Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
On 26 avr, 01:04, librarian <aucti...@superfuncards.com> wrote:
> Is the Khazar's action to create a wraith a (D) Action at the meth from
> whose ash heap the minion comes?

No. Actions that "target" ash heaps are undirected (would it be your
ash heap or your prey's doesn't make any difference). Prey and
predator can block. This particular action gets +1 stealth by the
Diar'ys cardtext (opposing to Daemonic Possession that gets no base
stealth).

> Also, once the wraith ally is created, since it is put in play, it may
> act immediately, correct? It does not have to wait in the uncontrolled
> like an ally that was recruited has to do, correct?

The wraith is not recruited, so it is not placed in the uncontrolled
area. It can act immediately.

in a thread not-so-long-ag, lsj explained that the khazars wraiths can't
be targetted by the ash-heap searching cards that require the minion to
be burned from play because once in the ash-heap they are no longer
those khazar-wraith allies. they return to being ally cards of whatever
type they have printed on them.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mathias wrote:
> When the minion card representing a Khazar's wraith burns will this
> reset the "since your last turn" check allowing it to be targeted by
> Daemonic Possession, Ghost-Eater and other effects, even if the minion
> card that was put into play was originally burned several turns
> earlier?

No. There is nothing to be reset. The minion on the card has not been burned
"since your last turn", so it can't be targeted by effects that look for such a
minion.
